title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in the Municipality of Bauang, Province of La Union, to Be Known as the Eulogio De Guzman High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in the Municipality of Bauang, Province of La Union, to Be Known as the Eulogio De Guzman High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Thị trấn Bauang, Tỉnh La Union được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Eulogio De Guzman
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในเทศบาล Bauang, จังหวัด La Union ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Eulogio De Guzman
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Kotamadya Bauang, Provinsi La Union dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Eulogio De Guzman
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Perbandaran Bauang, Wilayah La Union dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Eulogio De Guzman

text.en: There shall be established a high school in the Municipality of Bauang, Province of La Union, to be known as the Eulogio de Guzman High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
